lines.en: label beachwars3:
{i}You've received a new message from Niki Nakayama!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你收到了一条来自 Niki Nakayama 的新消息!{/i}

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene1
: Hah...
: Look at you, acting all exhausted even though nothing’s happened yet.
lines.zh: : 瞧你那副累坏了的样子,明明什么都还没发生呢。

lines.en: : It’s because I know things are {i}going{/i} to happen that I’m exhausted.
lines.zh: : 正因为我知道接下来{i}会{/i}发生什么,我才累。

lines.en: : Any minute now, I’m going to be indefinitely supervised by two girls who could probably beat me up if they wanted to and there’s nothing I can do but go along with it.
lines.zh: : 随时都会有那么两个女生来无限期地监视我,而她们要是想揍我,大概也揍得动,我除了顺着她们别无他法。

lines.en: : I mean, you {i}could{/i} always align yourself with one of the two floors and just push through your defenders and take the hug into your own hands. Or arms. Or both since it’s a hug.
lines.zh: : 我是说,你{i}大可以{/i}选边站到两层楼中的任意一边,推开你的防守者,自己把那个拥抱拿到手里。或者拿到怀里。或者两者都用上,毕竟是拥抱嘛。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is you can go hug somebody.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,你可以去抱别人。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene2
: Oh is {i}that{/i} what you meant? I didn’t quite catch that.
lines.zh: : 哦,你是{i}这个{/i}意思?我刚才没太听明白。

lines.en: : You sleep on the wrong side of Ami’s bed or something? You seem kinda grumpy today.
lines.zh: : 你昨晚睡错 Ami 的床那边了还是怎么的?你今天看起来有点暴躁。

lines.en: : I am an adult with my own adult bed, thank you very much. And I can be sarcastic if I want to be.
lines.zh: : 我是个有自己那张成人床的成年人,非常感谢。而且我想说反话就说反话。

lines.en: : It’s not the sarcasm I have an issue with, Senpai. It’s how you’re over here looking like you’re dead set on {i}not{/i} enjoying yourself for the rest of the weekend. Why?
lines.zh: : 我{i}不是{/i}在介意你说反话,前辈。我介意的是,你看起来打定主意整个周末都不打算享受。为什么?

lines.en: : You’re basically a celebrity during the Dorm Wars. Everybody’s fighting for {i}your{/i} attention. So why would anyone want to fight for some guy who just...mopes around all the time?
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战期间你基本就是个明星。所有人都在争{i}你的{/i}关注。那谁会想去争一个整天……闷闷不乐的家伙呢?

lines.en: : Hey, look. You’re finally starting to get it.
lines.zh: : 嘿,瞧。你终于开始懂了。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene3
: Wait, so you {i}don’t{/i} want to be the center of attention anymore? I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 等等,所以你现在{i}不想{/i}成为众人注目的中心了?我糊涂了。

lines.en: : I don’t know what I want. I’m confused too.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己想要什么。我也很糊涂。

lines.en: : It just feels like things are going to get even more difficult no matter what happens and I thought I’d have a little more time to kind of...blend into the background before coming back here.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得,不管发生什么,事情都会变得更难,而我以为在回到这里之前,自己还能多点时间……就这么混在背景里。

lines.en: : You’ve had more than half a year, haven’t you? We haven’t been here since Christmas.
lines.zh: : 你都有大半年的时间了不是吗?我们从圣诞节之后就没来过这儿。

lines.en: : And to me, it feels like Christmas was only a short while ago.
lines.zh: : 可对我来说,圣诞节就像是前不久的事。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene4
: Well, I can’t tell what’s going on in that big, pointy head of yours...like, ever. But I’m sure that whatever it is will turn out just fine in the long run.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你那个又大又尖的脑袋里在想什么,我从来……就看不懂。不过我相信不管是什么,长远来看都会有好结果的。

lines.en: : For now, just focus on relaxing until the time comes for the two of us to stare at a couple girls modeling swimsuits and striking suggestive poses. That should cheer you up, right?
lines.zh: : 现在嘛,先专心放松,等到时候我们俩一起盯着几个女生穿泳装、摆撩人的姿势就行。那总该能让你高兴起来吧?

lines.en: : I’d cheer up even quicker if I could see {i}you{/i} striking suggestive poses in a swimsuit. Why are you still wearing your normal clothes? You should relax too.
lines.zh: : 要是能看到{i}你{/i}穿泳装摆撩人的姿势,我会高兴得更快。你怎么还穿着平时的衣服?你也该放松一下。

lines.en: : Can I not relax in normal clothes? That’s what you’re doing. Or...{i}should{/i} be doing.
lines.zh: : 我穿平时的衣服就不能放松了吗?你不就是这样。或者说……应{i}该{/i}这样。

lines.en: : You {i}can,{/i} just-
lines.zh: : {i}可以{/i},只是-

lines.en: : Don’t worry about me. Just figure out a way to exist without dragging down everybody else on the beach. This trip is for {i}them{/i} at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 别担心我。想办法活下去,别把海滩上其他所有人都拖下水。说到底,这趟旅行是给{i}她们{/i}的。

lines.en: : All {i}we’re{/i} doing is chaperoning and giving them something to fantasize about when they crawl into their futons later tonight.
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}做的只是当监护人,顺便给她们今晚钻进被褥时提供点幻想的素材。

lines.en: : What will you fantasize about when you crawl into yours?
lines.zh: : 那你钻进你那床被褥时,会幻想些什么?

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene5
: Nothing. Because {i}I’m{/i} sleeping in the bed with Wakana and {i}you’re{/i} going to be the one stuck on the floor fantasizing about {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么都不会。因为{i}我{/i}要和 Wakana 睡那张床,而{i}你{/i}是那个被打发去睡地板、幻想{i}我们{/i}的人。

lines.en: : Or probably just Wakana because she’s the forbidden fruit. But I’ll also be there, so...
lines.zh: : 大概只会幻想 Wakana 吧,毕竟她是禁果。不过我也在那儿,所以……

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene6
: You know what? I’m just gonna go call her. But you should start watching your back, Senpai. Think it’s only a matter of time until there’s a target painted on it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我这就去给她打电话。不过你最好开始小心背后了,前辈。我觉得你背上被画上靶子只是时间问题。

lines.en: : I often think I was just born with one of those on me, so I’m not sure if there is anything I can do at this point to protect myself.
lines.zh: : 我常常觉得自己生下来背上就带着一个,所以到这一步,我也不知道还能做什么来保护自己。

lines.en: : Then rely on your bodyguards or whatever. Imani out.
lines.zh: : 那就指望你的保镖什么的吧。Imani 完毕。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene7
Imani wanders off to call Wakana and-
lines.zh: Imani 走开去给 Wakana 打电话,然后-

lines.en: And I get a call of my own.
lines.zh: 而我自己也接到了一通电话。

lines.en: scene sky
: Hello?
: Hey. Are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在有空吗?

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} free right now? Because I figured you’d be doing “famous idol” stuff.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}现在有空吗?因为我以为你在忙『著名偶像』的事呢。

lines.en: : I don’t like the sarcasm placed on “famous idol” there. Just because you don’t give a shit doesn’t mean millions of other people don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你把『著名偶像』说得这么阴阳怪气。你不在乎,不代表成千上万的人不在乎。

lines.en: : My bad. I woke up on the wrong side of Ami’s bed today.
lines.zh: : 我的错。我今天从 Ami 的床的错误那一边醒来了。

lines.en: : Why were you sleeping in Ami’s bed? Where did {i}she{/i} sleep?
lines.zh: : 你为什么睡在 Ami 的床上?{i}她{/i}睡哪儿?

lines.en: : Outside. What’s going on? Why are you calling?
lines.zh: : 外面。怎么了?你打电话干嘛?

lines.en: : Uhhhh...obviously because I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 呃……那还用说,因为我想见你。

lines.en: : Say it again, but in a more tsundere way this time.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,这次用傲娇一点的语气。

lines.en: : It’s not like I actually wanted to see you or anything, idiot. I just dialed your number on accident.
lines.zh: : 我才不是真的想见你呢,笨蛋。我只是不小心拨了你的号码。

lines.en: : That’s more like it. And thank you for going along with that so easily. I needed it.
lines.zh: : 这才像话。谢谢你这么配合。我需要这个。

lines.en: : Something wrong?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许吧。

lines.en: : Something I can help with?
lines.zh: : 有什么我能帮上忙的吗?

lines.en: : Sure. If you want to come over to the beach and have sex with me all night.
lines.zh: : 当然。如果你愿意来海滩跟我做一整晚的爱。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 好啊。

lines.en: : Really? Because I was being sarcastic again there.
lines.zh: : 真的?因为我刚才又在说反话了。

lines.en: : Do you want to fuck me or not? Because I have to figure out which outfit to wear and your answer to that will help me choose.
lines.zh: : 你到底想不想上我?因为我得决定穿哪套衣服,而你的回答会帮我选。

lines.en: : I do...I just don’t know how possible it will be when there are going to be over twenty other girls here who might-
lines.zh: : 想……我只是不知道能有多大可行性,毕竟这里会有二十多个女生-

lines.en: : I’m famous. I’ll figure it out. Now go jerk off or something so you’ll last longer.
lines.zh: : 我可是名人。我会想办法的。现在去打个飞机什么的,好让你持久一点。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. Let me just go jerk off behind a tree. That’s a safe thing to do on a public beach.
lines.zh: : 行,好啊。让我去树后面打个飞机。在公共海滩上干这事可真安全。

lines.en: : Wow, you really {i}are{/i} sassy today, huh? Whatever. Save that attitude for the bedroom. Bye.
lines.zh: : 哇,你今天嘴{i}可真{/i}利索啊?算了。把这股劲儿留到床上。拜。

lines.en: : Oh, love you. I think we’re supposed to say that now.
lines.zh: : 哦,爱你。我觉得我们现在该说这个了。

lines.en: : Are we?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah. So say it back, asshole.
lines.zh: : 对。所以你也说回来,混蛋。

lines.en: : I...love you too.
lines.zh: : 我……也爱你。

lines.en: : Say it again, but in a more tsundere way this time.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,这次用傲娇一点的语气。

lines.en: : It’s not like I actually love you or anything. I’m just saying it because you’re making me.
lines.zh: : 我才不是真的爱你呢。我只是在说,因为是你逼我的。

lines.en: : Amazing. I’m wet already.
lines.zh: : 太棒了。我已经湿了。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Aaaand now I’m hanging up.
lines.zh: : 啊——我要挂了。

lines.en: scene black
Niki ends the call and...I suddenly have something to look forward to tonight.
lines.zh: Niki 挂断电话,然后……我突然对今晚有了期待。

lines.en: Something it’s {i}okay{/i} to look forward to.
lines.zh: 一件{i}可以{/i}期待的事。

lines.en: Something I can’t be condemned or ridiculed for because it’s a thing I love to do with a person I’m meant to be with.
lines.zh: 一件不会被谴责、被嘲笑的事,因为那是我爱和那个注定与我相伴的人做的事。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene8
But what if there is more than one person I am meant to be with?
lines.zh: 可如果我注定要相伴的人不止一个呢?

lines.en: How can I be with all of them?
lines.zh: 我要怎么才能和她们所有人在一起?

lines.en: But more importantly...how can I be {i}myself{/i} when there are pieces of me scattered all along the shoreline?
lines.zh: 但更重要的是……当我的碎片散落在整条海岸线上时,我要怎么做回我{i}自己{/i}?

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: So I’ll ignore it again.
lines.zh: 所以我会再次无视它。

lines.en: Until this cross becomes too heavy.
lines.zh: 直到这副十字架变得太沉重。

lines.en: Until my back is broken.
lines.zh: 直到我的背被压断。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene9
: Look at me. My name’s Maya. I’m all stoic and cool. I love watermelons and have a really nice ass. Anyone want to go read Goodnight Punpun under a bridge?
lines.zh: : 看看我。我叫 Maya。我超级冷酷又帅气。我爱西瓜,屁股还特别好看。有人想一起去桥底下读《晚安布布》吗?

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene10
: What the fuck are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在干什么?

lines.en: : Mocking you. That’s what mortal enemies do, right?
lines.zh: : 嘲笑你啊。死敌不就是干这个的吗?

lines.en: : I meant why do you think it’s suddenly acceptable to sit next to me when I want to wear your skin as a suit?
lines.zh: : 我是问,在我想把你的皮扒下来当衣服穿的时候,你怎么突然觉得坐我旁边是可以接受的了?

lines.en: : Because we’re going to be competing all weekend long and I wanted to say good luck before I absolutely decimate you.
lines.zh: : 因为我们整个周末都要比赛,我想在把你彻底碾碎之前先说声祝你好运。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene11
: As if I have any interest in this stupid competition. Get lost.
lines.zh: : 我对你那愚蠢的比赛可没什么兴趣。滚开。

lines.en: : I mean...the fact that you still abhor me is kind of indicative of you having {i}some{/i} semblance of interest in this competition, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你到现在还这么讨厌我,{i}某种{/i}程度上正说明你对这场比赛有点兴趣,对吧?

lines.en: : Unless you prefer all of your “hugs” with Sensei to remain totally private so nobody knows you’re just as thirsty for him as the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 除非你更希望和 Sensei 的所有『拥抱』都完全私密,好让没人知道你跟我们其他人一样渴求他。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene12
: I will rip your fucking tongue out, you brightly-colored waste of carbon.
lines.zh: : 我要把你他妈的舌头扯出来,你这个颜色鲜艳的碳基废物。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene13
: Aaaahhhh...
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : Wh...What the fuck do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : 你……你他妈在干什么?!

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene14
: Helping. You wanna rip it out, right? Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 帮忙啊。你想把它扯出来,对吧?来吧。

lines.en: : It’d probably be easiest if you used your teeth. Doing it with your fingers might get a little slippery.
lines.zh: : 用牙齿大概最容易。用手指的话可能会有点滑。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene15
: Get...the fuck...away from me.
lines.zh: : 给……我……滚开。

lines.en: : Buhhyouhavnbaoffmahhtonnyeh. Aaaahhh.
lines.zh: : 可你还没……快把你的手从我舌头上拿开。啊啊啊。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene16
: {i}Just fucking die already!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你他妈去死吧!{/i}

lines.en: : So...it appears we meet again.
lines.zh: : 那么……看来我们又见面了。

lines.en: : And this time I won’t be distracted by some bitch’s face as I beat her within inches of her life.
lines.zh: : 而这一次,我不会被某个婊子的脸分心,我会把你打得半死。

lines.en: : That sounds unfortunate for you as the only time you could ever hurt anyone is while I am {i}not{/i} paying attention to you. And I will have my eyes on you until my floor obtains our much deserved points.
lines.zh: : 听起来对你不利,因为你唯一能伤到人的时候,就是我{i}没{/i}在注意你的时候。而在我们这层楼拿到应得的分数之前,我的眼睛会一直盯着你。

lines.en: : You want those lousy ass points that badly? What’s a girl like you doing chasing after some perverted teacher, anyway? Shouldn’t you be off running your daddy’s noodle shop or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你那么想要那些烂分数?像你这样的姑娘追着一个变态老师跑什么?你不是该去经营你爸的面条店什么的吗?

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen is closed for the weekend as this matter was more important.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 这个周末歇业,因为这件事更重要。

lines.en: : And while I am not personally chasing after our strange teacher, it does not change the fact that my friends are and I wish to help them.
lines.zh: : 而且虽然我个人并没有在追我们那位奇怪的老师,但这并不改变我的朋友们在追、而我想帮她们这个事实。

lines.en: : Same here. But the difference between you and me is that your friends are all weird as fuck and my friend is just too fuckin’ lovedrunk to see how stupid she is.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。但你我的区别在于,你的朋友们一个比一个怪,而我的朋友只是爱昏了头,看不出自己有多蠢。

lines.en: : Then the difference between you and me is that you fight on behalf of one person while I carry the hopes and dreams of nine. You are not my equal. You will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 那我们的区别在于,你是为一个人而战,而我背负着九个人的希望与梦想。你不是我的对手。你会被摧毁。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene17
: You talk pretty big for somebody who only got the upper hand {i}once{/i} just because I was distracted.
lines.zh: : 你口气倒是不小,也就因为我分心的时候才占过{i}一次{/i}上风。

lines.en: : Remaining focused on the battlefield is the key to victory. Failure to do so could result in {i}death{/i} if one is not careful.
lines.zh: : 在战场上保持专注是取胜的关键。稍不注意,失败就可能导致{i}死亡{/i}。

lines.en: : You sayin’ you’re gonna kill me? Over a stupid-ass contest?
lines.zh: : 你是说你要杀了我?就为了一个蠢透了的比赛?

lines.en: : There is nothing stupid about following one’s dreams.
lines.zh: : 追寻自己的梦想,一点也不蠢。

lines.en: : Even if that dream is some pervert’s tiny dick?
lines.zh: : 哪怕那个梦想是某个变态的小鸡巴?

lines.en: : Some prefer salt broth. Some prefer soy.
lines.zh: : 有人爱盐味汤底。有人爱酱油汤底。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene18
: {i}Heh?{/i}
: It is important to not ridicule someone’s tastes just because they’re different from your own.
lines.zh: : 重要的是,不要因为别人的口味和你不同而嘲笑他们。

lines.en: : That is one of many lessons I will teach over the next forty-eight hours.
lines.zh: : 这是我在接下来的四十八小时里要教的众多课程之一。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene16
: You ain’t teaching me shit, you noodley bitch.
lines.zh: : 你什么也教不了我,你这个面条婊子。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene19
: It’s difficult to teach those who are unwilling to learn. And in situations like this, it’s not uncommon to rely on {i}force{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : 不愿学的人,是很难教的。而在这种情况下,转而依赖{i}武力{/i}也不少见。

lines.en: : Just try it and see how that goes for you, punk.
lines.zh: : 那就试试看,看看你下场如何,小混混。

lines.en: : Hey. How was your phone call? Is Wakana still mad at me?
lines.zh: : 嘿。电话打得怎么样?Wakana 还在生我的气吗?

lines.en: : She was more mad that she has to come all the way here just to deliver the results of her contest. But apparently like 80%% of the entrants were from our class, so the timing just kind of worked out in our favor.
lines.zh: : 她更气的是得大老远跑来这儿,只为宣布她那场比赛的结果。不过据说参赛者里大概 80%% 都来自我们班,所以时间上正好便宜了我们。

lines.en: : That said, the fuck is going on here? Yumi and Tsuneyo look like they’re going to kill each other. And Maya and Noriko...{i}also{/i} look like they’re going to kill each other.
lines.zh: : 话说回来,这里到底是什么情况?Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 看起来恨不得杀了对方。而 Maya 和 Noriko……{i}也{/i}看起来恨不得杀了对方。

lines.en: : I guess that one's not really new, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那对倒也不算新鲜事。

lines.en: : Either way, I disappear for five seconds and everything turns to shit. How the hell did you ever manage without me?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样,我就消失了五秒钟,一切就全乱套了。没有我你到底是怎么撑过来的?

lines.en: : No clue, but I’m pretty sure this is just how it’s going to be all weekend long thanks to Makoto’s brilliant contest idea.
lines.zh: : 不知道,不过我敢肯定,多亏 Makoto 那个绝妙的比赛点子,整个周末都会是这个样子。

lines.en: : Well, great. I guess here’s hoping you’re actually conscious enough to help me pull the girls apart this time since Tsuneyo clearly won’t be able to.
lines.zh: : 行吧,真棒。那这次希望你还算清醒,能帮我把她们拉开,毕竟 Tsuneyo 显然指望不上了。

lines.en: : I doubt it will come to that. But, then again, if they’re already this combative before the contest has even started, it’s hard to say how things will be once it {i}has.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我怀疑还没到那一步。不过话说回来,如果比赛还没开始她们就已经这么好斗了,{i}开始{/i}之后会怎么样可就难说了。

lines.en: : When {i}does{/i} this contest start anyway? I don’t remember hearing a time.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛{i}到底{/i}什么时候开始?我不记得听到过时间。

lines.en: : I don’t think there was one. I think it’s just whenever Uta and Makoto see fit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没有时间。我觉得就看 Uta 和 Makoto 什么时候觉得合适。

lines.en: : Gotcha.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : That’s about to happen, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 那件事快要发生了,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m glad I wasn’t the only one who was feeling it.
lines.zh: : 很高兴不是只有我一个人有这种感觉。

lines.en: scene sky
: Attention, everyone!
lines.zh: : 大家注意!

lines.en: : Seeing as tensions are just about to boil over, me and Makoto-
lines.zh: : 眼看局势就要失控,我和 Makoto-

lines.en: : Makoto and I.
lines.zh: : Makoto 和我。

lines.en: : Makoto and Makoto have decided to announce the start of her weird hug fight! All combatants, go! Go! Gooooooo!
lines.zh: : Makoto 和 Makoto 决定宣布她那场奇怪的拥抱大战开始!全体参赛者,上!上!上——————!

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene20
: Feel the power of friendship!
lines.zh: : 感受友谊的力量吧!

lines.en: : Wha- I wasn’t ready, you fucking bitch!
lines.zh: : 什么- 我还没准备好,你这个该死的婊子!

lines.en: : As mentioned...being prepared on the battlefield is of utmost importance! You...have dug your own grave!
lines.zh: : 如前所述……在战场上做好准备才是最重要的!你……这是自掘坟墓!

lines.en: : The...fuck! Let go of my leg! Fight me standing up and...save both of us some...fucking dignity!
lines.zh: : 他……妈的!放开我的腿!站起来跟我打,给……我们俩都留点……他妈的尊严!

lines.en: : Yumi! Tsuneyo! You’re meant to be guarding Sensei! Not fighting each other!
lines.zh: : Yumi!Tsuneyo!你们该做的是守住 Sensei!不是互相打!

lines.en: : See, this is exactly why your contest was a bad idea, Makocchi. Nobody gets the rules and now we’re gonna lose one of our classmates.
lines.zh: : 瞧,这正是你那比赛是个烂主意的原因,Makocchi。没人搞得懂规则,现在我们还得搭上一个同学。

lines.en: : Forget our classmates, the Tsukioka Foundation is almost sure to pull their funding if someone dies on our watch.
lines.zh: : 别管同学了,要是有人在我们眼皮子底下死了,Tsukioka 财团几乎肯定会撤资。

lines.en: : Crap! Tsuneyo! Just knock her out! Don’t go for the kill!
lines.zh: : 靠!Tsuneyo!直接把她打晕!别下杀手!

lines.en: : Yumi! Regain control! You need to get on top!
lines.zh: : Yumi!重新夺回控制!你得压到上面去!

lines.en: : Easier...said than done!
lines.zh: : 说……得容易!

lines.en: : Noriko! Seize the opportunity and charge the target!
lines.zh: : Noriko!抓住机会,冲向目标!

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene21
: On it!
lines.zh: : 收到!

lines.en: : Wait one fucking second, you’re seriously-
lines.zh: : 给我等他妈一秒,你真的-

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene22
: Wha-
lines.zh: : 什么-

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene23
: I will fucking murder you!
lines.zh: : 我要杀了你!

lines.en: : Early bird gets the worm, bitch!
lines.zh: : 早起的鸟儿有虫吃,婊子!

lines.en: : Ami! Help!
lines.zh: : Ami!救命!

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene24
: As if you even had to ask...
lines.zh: : 你根本不用开口……

lines.en: : Tch. I should have known this was coming.
lines.zh: : 啧。我早该知道会这样。

lines.en: if norikoblock == True:

: Hey, Ami. Don’t you think you might be a little {i}too{/i} attached to Sensei? Like, in a way that’s definitely really weird. And how you should probably stop because you’re suffocating him and incest is illegal.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Ami。你不觉得自己对 Sensei 依恋得有点{i}过头{/i}了吗?就是那种……绝对很怪的过头。而且你大概该停下来了,因为你在让他窒息,而且乱伦是违法的。

lines.en: : No. I don’t think any of that. And right now, all that matters is protecting him from your evil clutches.
lines.zh: : 不。我一点都不觉得。而现在最重要的,是保护他不受你那邪恶魔爪的伤害。

lines.en: : Evil? You’ve known me since I was little. You know I’m not evil.
lines.zh: : 邪恶?我从小就认识你了。你知道我不邪恶。

lines.en: : You’re the only one with memories going back that far. And I’m sorry to break the news like this, but all of my memory space is reserved for Sensei. There’s no room for you in there.
lines.zh: : 你是唯一一个拥有那么久远记忆的人。而我很抱歉要这样告诉你,但我所有的记忆空间都预留给了 Sensei。里面没有你的位置。

lines.en: else:
: If you want to get to Sensei, you’ll have to go through me.
lines.zh: : 想接近 Sensei,就得先过我这关。

lines.en: : Ami, I’m bigger and stronger than you. And also an expert when it comes to tickling. You stand no chance. Now, step aside.
lines.zh: : Ami,我比你高大,也比你壮。而且在挠痒痒这件事上我是专家。你没有胜算。现在,让开。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene25
: Tickle me if you must! I will never stop protecting Sensei! No matter {i}how{/i} many of you must tickle me!
lines.zh: : 想挠就挠吧!我永远都不会停止保护 Sensei!不管有{i}多少{/i}人要来挠我!

lines.en: : Shh, you’re going to give people ideas and it’s going to turn into a whole thing. Just move out of the way. The sleepover is at your house. You’re going to be there either way.
lines.zh: : 嘘,你会给大家出主意的,到时候又会闹成一团。让开就行。睡衣派对在你家办。反正你到时候也在。

lines.en: : And {i}let{/i} you wrap your filthy arms around my uncle?! Never!
lines.zh: : 然后{i}让{/i}你用你那肮脏的胳膊抱我叔叔?!休想!

lines.en: : Good, Ami! Now I-
lines.zh: : 干得好,Ami!现在我-

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene26
: You stay put too! Nobody hugs Sensei but me and I’ll win this contest on my own!
lines.zh: : 你也给我待着别动!除了我谁也不许抱 Sensei,我要一个人赢下这场比赛!

lines.en: scene sky
: We’ll see about that!
lines.zh: : 那就走着瞧!

lines.en: As expected, the beach quickly erupts into chaos and all of the girls who haven’t already wandered off or gone back to the inn are left scrambling through the sand.
lines.zh: 不出所料,海滩很快陷入一片混乱,所有还没走开或回旅馆的女生都在沙地里手忙脚乱。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene27
All but a few of them, of course.
lines.zh: 当然,除了那么几个。

lines.en: My so-called {i}bodyguards{/i} are too busy trying to kill each other to properly guard me. And with Ami chasing off Noriko and Maya as disinterested in making a move as ever, I think I’m safe for now.
lines.zh: 我那所谓的{i}保镖{/i}们忙着互相残杀,根本顾不上好好守着我。而 Ami 把 Noriko 赶跑、Maya 又一如既往地毫无行动欲望,我觉得自己暂时是安全的。

lines.en: Or at least as safe as I possibly {i}can{/i} be in an environment where, as Imani said, there is a target painted on my back.
lines.zh: 或者说,在 Imani 说的那个我背上画着靶子的环境里,尽可{i}能{/i}安全。

lines.en: Perhaps it would be easiest to just lie down and let whichever arrow is flying the fastest pierce my heart.
lines.zh: 也许最简单的办法就是躺下来,让那支飞得最快的箭刺穿我的心脏。

lines.en: The issue with that is that there would be no one there to {i}remove{/i} those arrows, and that I’d be covered from head to toe in open wounds before I even know it.
lines.zh: 问题是,那样一来就没有人替我把那些箭{i}拔{/i}出来了,而我会在不知不觉间从头到脚布满伤口。

lines.en: What matters in times like these is remembering who you are and where you come from.
lines.zh: 在这种时候,重要的是记住你是谁、你来自哪里。

lines.en: What matters is casting aside all expectations of forward momentum and surrounding yourself with familiar skin that will fuse to the ground and keep you right where you are.
lines.zh: 重要的是抛开一切关于向前推进的期待,用熟悉的皮囊把自己包围起来,让它与地面黏合,把你牢牢钉在原地。

lines.en: Some people call that cowardice.
lines.zh: 有人管这叫懦弱。

lines.en: But me?
lines.zh: 但换作我?

lines.en: I call it risk management.
lines.zh: 我叫它风险管理。

lines.en: And there’s a certain level of comfort to be found in remembering you’ll never trip if you don’t try to walk.
lines.zh: 而记住『不试着走路就永远不会摔倒』,本身就带着某种安心感。

lines.en: : So, Sensei! Any plans for the rest of the morning? Or are you gonna stick around and watch what’ll probably just become a permanent boxing match?
lines.zh: : 那么,Sensei!今天上午余下的时间有什么安排?还是说你要留在这儿,看这场大概会变成永久拳击赛的好戏?

lines.en: : I think the plan is to just stay here until someone decides for me what I’ll be doing instead.
lines.zh: : 我想计划就是待在这儿,直到有人替我决定我接下来该干什么。

lines.en: : Then-
lines.zh: : 那么-

lines.en: : Then, would you like to maybe accompany me for a little while?
lines.zh: : 那么,你愿意陪我一小会儿吗?

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene28
: Whaaaat? No fair! I was about to ask the same thing.
lines.zh: : 什么——?不公平!我正想问同样的事呢。

lines.en: : Well, you should have moved faster.
lines.zh: : 那你该动作快点。

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene29
: Is that okay, Sensei? It won’t be long. I just have a few more papers for you to sign, if that’s okay. And I need your final approval for this year's Dorm Wars official itinerary.
lines.zh: : 可以吗,Sensei?不会太久。我还有几份文件要你签字,如果可以的话。而且我需要你对今年的宿舍大战正式行程做最后审批。

lines.en: : Well, it appears my decision has been made for me. I hereby formally apologize to everyone who didn’t ask as quickly as Makoto.
lines.zh: : 看来我的决定已经被人替我做好了。我在此正式向所有没有 Makoto 问得那么快的人道歉。

lines.en: : God frickin’ damn it. How come she’s so good at stealin’ Sensei away from the rest of us? Like, don’t ya see enough of that guy in school? Cut us some slack. Right, girls?
lines.zh: : 真他妈的。她怎么这么擅长把 Sensei 从我们这些人身边偷走?我说,你们在学校里还没看够那个家伙吗?给我们留点机会吧。对吧,姑娘们?

lines.en: scene thirdbeachwarsscene30
: Girls?
lines.zh: : 姑娘们?

lines.en: : Oh. Y...Yeah. Cut us some slack.
lines.zh: : 哦。当……当然。给我们留点机会。

lines.en: : Now, then. Shall we get going?
lines.zh: : 那么,我们走吧?

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m actually reading whatever papers you’re making me go over this time so you can’t pull one over on me again.
lines.zh: : 行。不过这次你要我过目的那些文件我是真要看的,免得你再糊弄我。

lines.en: : Oh, please. As if I’d ever trick you like that.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。我怎么会那样骗你呢。

lines.en: scene black
With Makoto’s help, I manage to escape the chaos and come a little bit closer to a breath of fresh air.
lines.zh: 在 Makoto 的帮助下,我总算从混乱里脱身,又离一口新鲜空气近了一点。

lines.en: $ beachwars3 = True
jump beachwars4
